fields.name: employee_name
fields.hint: the name on the pay stub, verbatim

fields.name: employer_name
fields.hint: the employer that issued the stub

fields.name: pay_frequency
fields.hint: the pay frequency stated on the stub

fields.name: pay_period_end
fields.hint: the stub's pay period end date, YYYY-MM-DD

fields.name: ytd_base_pay
fields.hint: year-to-date base pay, no currency symbol

fields.name: ytd_overtime_pay
fields.hint: year-to-date overtime pay, or null if the stub states none

fields.name: overtime_periods_paid
fields.hint: how many pay periods this year paid overtime, or null if none was paid

fields.name: overtime_periods_total
fields.hint: how many pay periods have elapsed this year, or null if no overtime was paid

fields.name: ytd_bonus_pay
fields.hint: year-to-date bonus pay, or null if the stub states none

fields.name: bonus_recurring
fields.hint: does the Bonus History section describe an actual history of the bonus recurring across two or more prior payments (an annual/quarterly bonus with stated payment history), or a one-time/discretionary payment? A note that merely uses the word 'annual' or 'recurring' with no stated payment history is 'no' -- the label alone is not history. null if no bonus this year.
